scope_and_indexing.publisher: Institute of Physiology, Czech Academy of Sciences
scope_and_indexing.SCIE: Current official homepage explicitly lists Science Citation Index Expanded (SciSearch). Independent Clarivate master-list verification was not performed in this audit.

limits.figure_legend_and_table_word_count: Not explicitly separated or excluded; for conservative audit report both an inclusive whole-document word count and the guide-explicit scope.

title_page.author_names: Given names and family names, not initials alone.
title_page.affiliations: Numbered affiliations with each author assigned corresponding number(s).
title_page.corresponding_author: Full postal address, plus existing confirmed email retained as practical contact information.
title_page.identifier: ORCID iD or Researcher ID; general Authors Identification paragraph qualifies this as if available. Do not invent identifiers.
title_page.running_title: Required, at most 60 characters including spaces.

required_sequence: DECLARATION on the Use of AI when applicable
manuscript_structure.additional_transparency_sections: Retain accurate conflict-of-interest, contributions and data-availability statements; reviewed official guide did not explicitly require these section names.
manuscript_structure.font_and_spacing: No specific font family, font size or line spacing requirement located in the current guide.
manuscript_structure.units: SI with conventional equivalent in parentheses when needed; journal specifies lower-case l for liter.

references.in_text: Consecutive bracketed numerals in first-citation order, e.g. [1], [1-3], [1,3,7].
references.list: Numbered entries with a period after each number, in citation order.
references.author_rule_original_article: List up to seven authors; for more than seven, first seven followed by et al.
references.doi: Omit DOI from submitted reference entries; guide says Editorial Office adds DOI later.
references.example_style: Surname AB, Surname CD. Article title. Abbrev J Name 2026;75:1-10.
references.conflict: Review subsection requests all authors and a reused example lists eleven authors, whereas the explicit Original Article rule says maximum seven then et al. Apply the type-specific Original Article rule.

figures_tables_and_files.reviewer_pdf: Required single PDF containing text and all tables and figures, placed at manuscript end.
figures_tables_and_files.word_manuscript: Required Word version; use .docx. Include the end matter tables and figures for an unequivocally complete manuscript; revised Word files are expressly required to include both.
figures_tables_and_files.figure_separate_files: Required. Submit JPG files to satisfy the submission-specific instruction; retaining TIFF source versions separately is acceptable preparation but unnecessary duplication in the email should be avoided.
figures_tables_and_files.figure_resolution: At least 1000 pixels width/height, or 300 dpi or higher; high-resolution existing plots exceed both thresholds.
figures_tables_and_files.color: RGB 8-bit per channel encouraged; no extra fee for color.
figures_tables_and_files.captions: Explanatory figure captions at end of manuscript text and enough detail for independent understanding.
figures_tables_and_files.table_separate_files: Not explicitly mandatory, but official filename examples include a separate author_table1.docx. Supply an editable separate table as well as embedding it at the end of Word/PDF.
figures_tables_and_files.filename_rule: Begin with first author family name, e.g. Yuan.docx, Yuan.pdf, Yuan_fig1.jpg, Yuan_table1.docx.
figures_tables_and_files.archives: Send individual files, do not send a .rar archive. A .zip-specific permission was not found; individual files are the safer compliant form.

ai_declaration.exact_heading: DECLARATION on the Use of AI
required_content: specific uses, including analysis and drafting/editing when applicable
author verification of output factual accuracy and responsibility
ai_declaration.application_to_current_paper: Disclose actual Codex assistance for language, organization, method review, worksheet/statistical checking and conventional plotting scripts. Do not claim AI-generated experimental data/images. State a recorded model identifier only if genuinely available; otherwise identify the tool/date and explicitly report exact model version not archived.
ai_declaration.unresolved: The guide expressly asks for version. A truthful tool/date statement with version unavailable is transparent but cannot be represented as strictly satisfying an unknown exact-model requirement. Do not fabricate a version.

ethics_and_funding.animal_research: Methods must explicitly address applicable animal care guidance and institutional ethics approval. The guide names the 1985 NIH care guide or European animal-care guidance; do not claim retrospective protocol compliance beyond available records.
ethics_and_funding.ARRIVE: No explicit ARRIVE statement requirement located in this guide. Do not equate reporting guidance with ethical approval.
ethics_and_funding.current_paper: Retain confirmed AHUCM-rats-2022032, actual lack of postoperative analgesia and unavailable written rationale; no claims of pain exemption or no pain without evidence.
ethics_and_funding.funding: Acknowledgments must identify all actual support and grant details, including publication-cost support if applicable.

supplementary_material.explicit_preparation_rules: No supplementary-file size limit, mandatory naming scheme or upload workflow found in reviewed current author guide/contributor pages.
supplementary_material.practical_preparation: Retain separate clearly labeled supporting data, analysis scripts and supplementary figures, with a manuscript inventory and ordinary file attachments. Do not silently remove the source values or provenance limitations.
supplementary_material.published_usage: Official published articles reference supplementary material, and publisher-hosted supplementary datasets exist, but these do not establish a mandatory author-deposit workflow.

submission.mode: Email attachments, not a web portal.
submission.contact_page_note: Contact page lists both addresses, but submission-specific pages use physres@fgu.cas.cz; use the latter for any eventual submission.
submission.cover_note: Email note or cover letter must confirm original unpublished work and no concurrent consideration. Disclose the related publication and reused descriptive blood-pressure records accurately rather than claiming no overlap of any kind.
submission.reviewers: Authors may be asked to propose four foreign reviewers with names and email addresses. Not an unconditional initial-submission requirement.
submission.review_process: Single-blind; at least two reviews, third if first two strongly disagree.
submission.no_action_performed: No email sent and no manuscript submitted in this audit.

fees.excess_length: Editorial Office may charge extra for text exceeding stated limits.
fees.due: After acceptance; guide says accepted paper will not proceed or appear as preprint until APC is received.

not_required_by_reviewed_guide: a preselected four-referee list for every initial submission
an ARRIVE compliance assertion regardless of records
conflicts_and_uncertainties: One submission bullet calls Word rtf/doc, later text-format bullet calls rtf/docx and examples use docx; use docx.
Submission bullet says JPG; general figure-format paragraph allows JPG/TIFF/GIF; deliver JPG for journal attachment and preserve original TIFF source separately.
Single-reviewer PDF explicitly includes end tables/figures; revised Word explicitly includes them; initial Word wording is less explicit. Include in both.
Original Article reference-author rule is maximum seven then et al., despite an inconsistent reused example and a different Review rule.
ORCID appears in title-page instructions but general identification paragraph says if available; no identifier should be invented.
Supplementary material transfer/deposit details are not specified; present a clear inventory and attach individual files.
Exact AI version must not be fabricated; report unavailable archived model identifier honestly.
An excess-length surcharge is mentioned; remaining below all relevant limits is preferable rather than assuming over-limit text accepted.
